description: Allow the truth to reveal itself #selflove #trusttheprocess
transcript: You do not have to do much digging. The truth will always make its way to the surface. That is why I always proceed with caution when it comes to people, places, and things because I allow flow to reveal the truth. Do not go digging for things. That is not my responsibility. My responsibility is to allow flow to move in tandem. The more that I sit in silence and allow things to reveal themselves, I get clarity. I get the truth revealed to me.
